description: Old name for create_test; use create_test.

address.description: With `goal`: where to check, when it is not the app's usual address.

feature.description: A word for what this test is about, kept as a TAG on the test (tests are grouped by tags, not by feature). Check the group later with check_test and its tags. With `tests`, the name plan_tests returned.

goal.description: What should work, in one or two sentences, with the result in it: "A new customer can sign up and lands on their account page." Tada writes the test and checks it. Send the same sentence again after a fix: Tada keeps to the test it wrote for it.

hideSelectors.description: CSS selectors of the app's own floating widgets to hide for the whole check: a chat bubble, a cookie banner. A step that touches one fails.

initScript.description: JavaScript run in every page before the app's own scripts, to seed state the app reads at boot, such as a locale.

presentation.description: How the passed check is filmed. { layout: 'landing' } makes a 16:10 film with the app filling the frame, for a website, plus a short muted loop; add captions: true to draw captions. Leave it out for the usual film.

captions.description: With 'landing': draw the captions, small, at the bottom. Off unless true.

layout.description: 'landing': a 16:10 film with the app filling the frame, for a website, plus a short muted loop. 'call' (the default): the usual film.

repo.description: The app, as "owner/name". Left out, the workspace's only app. Steps need no app.

role.description: With `goal`: who is signed in, in the app's own word ("admin"). about_app lists the test accounts.

signIn.description: Ask Tada for a test account in a role it does not have, before the check (create_test_account does the same). Sent alone, nothing is checked.

email.description: Only when a sign-in was already made for Tada in the app: its address. Tada adopts it.

password.description: The password of the sign-in named by `email`. Tada seals it and never hands it back.

role.description: The role, in the app's own word: "admin", "client", "staff".

steps.description: The steps of one test, in order: open the app with a `goto` first, find things by the words a person reads, and after each action that matters add an `expect` (`text`, `urlIncludes` or `selector`) for what the screen then shows. To check that something is NOT on the page, add `absent: true` to an expect with `text` or `selector`: { action: "expect", text: "Untitled form", absent: true } passes once it is confirmed not visible within about two seconds. A test with no expect proves nothing. Sign in with {{secret.TADA_TEST_EMAIL}} and {{secret.TADA_TEST_PASSWORD}}, or `role` on a step.

tests.description: Every test of a feature planned with plan_tests, named as the plan names them, each with its steps. Send with `feature`.

ticket.description: The ticket id as the tracker writes it, for example SOL-123. Kept as the test's reference.

title.description: With `steps`: what the test is called.

name: verify_feature
